description: Authoritative license and notice evidence for utility packages in the current SBOM. Entries establish evidence and do not assert that a restored package is shipped.

entries.evidenceNotes: The 4.4.0 NuGet metadata declares Apache-2.0 and pins the exact repository commit. No upstream NOTICE file exists at the release tag.
The 6.1.1 NuGet metadata declares Apache-2.0 and pins the exact repository commit. No upstream NOTICE file exists at the release tag.
The exact release tag and NuGet repository commit agree. NOTICE.txt attributes the Joda Time-derived portions and must accompany the Apache-2.0 license evidence when NodaTime is redistributed.
The exact release tag supplies Vladimir Khorikov's MIT copyright and permission notice; the NuGet package independently declares MIT.

Caveat: upstream has no 2025.2.2 Git tag, and the 2025.2.2 NuGet metadata omits a repository commit. The package itself declares MIT and Copyright (c) 2016-2025 JetBrains s.r.o.; the closest preceding authoritative Git ref is 2025.2.1, whose verbatim MIT file is retained here and says 2016-2024. This mapping must not be represented as exact source-ref provenance for 2025.2.2.
The NuGet metadata pins this exact repository commit and declares MIT. The authoritative file preserves Nikita Tsukanov's 2021 copyright notice.
The NuGet metadata pins this exact release/0.92 commit and declares MIT. COPYING retains the Alp Toker, contributors, and Tom Deseyn copyright notices.

All three exact package IDs are produced from the same repository/version. Their NuGet metadata pins this commit and declares MIT. Exact names intentionally avoid matching unrelated TestableIO packages.
